name: Verified Pay-Per-Call Catalog
description: Static, machine-readable catalog of pay-per-call (x402) agent services with factual results of automated checks (reachability, latency, advertised vs quoted vs charged price, valid response). No grades. No funds held.

skills.name: Search the catalog
skills.description: Filter services by text, category, maximum advertised price, or reachable in the last check. Read catalog.json (static) or use the MCP server in the repository.
examples: web search under $0.01 that was reachable today

skills.name: Reliability lookup
skills.description: Is an endpoint reliable for task X at price <= Y? GET https://verified-catalog-lookup.withgrokbot.workers.dev/v1/lookup?task=<task>&max_price=<usd>&n=5 returns matching services sorted by known-answer pass rate over the last n paid calls, then price, with receipts.

skills.name: Get one service
skills.description: Full record for one service id, including the latest check and a raw log link.
